scenes.title: Mining run
scenes.cap: Mining runBeam on rock, cracks spreading, freed ore drifting into the hold. Hold squares fill one by one — the greed clock starts here.

scenes.title: Asteroid wave drop
scenes.cap: Asteroid wave dropA new wave spawns nearer the center and the whole lobby converges on the same rock. The metronome that forces contact.

scenes.title: Sieging a defended planet — alone
scenes.cap: Sieging a defended planet — aloneTwo turrets + shield vs one ship. Your hull is bleeding, their core is untouched. The GDD's promise: an occupied planet punishes a lone attacker.

scenes.title: Two attackers crack the turtle
scenes.cap: Two attackers crack the turtleUnspoken alliance: constant damage means shields never regen and the owner can't channel repair. Why being the leader is dangerous.

scenes.title: Home defense — the ship is the wall
scenes.cap: Home defense — the ship is the wallTurrets deter; you and the turrets together kill. The raider breaks off burning. Being home is what makes turrets matter.

scenes.title: Repair channel
scenes.cap: Repair channelParked at your own core, ore draining, HP crawling back. Any hit cancels it. Repair costs the two things you can't spare: ore and time.

scenes.title: Dogfight in open space
scenes.cap: Dogfight in open spaceClass identity decides it: the Excavator wins if it lands the beam, the Interceptor wins if it doesn't have to. Same beam that mines.

scenes.title: Interception — the loaded hauler
scenes.cap: Interception — the loaded haulerA full hold is a target. Kill it and half that ore spills into space. The reason "one more rock" is a real gamble.

scenes.title: The alarm — the game's whole design in one frame
scenes.cap: The alarm — the game's whole design in one frameDeep in the field, hold nearly full, and your core starts taking hits. Every system exists to make this second hurt.

scenes.title: Death & spill
scenes.cap: Death & spillShips are cheap: 5 seconds, upgrades intact. But half your hold is now loose in space for anyone. The cost is time and position, never progress.

scenes.title: Wreck scavenging
scenes.cap: Wreck scavengingThe dead player's ore stays on the map, and nobody can haul it away in one trip. Small cargo turns a corpse into a battlefield.

scenes.title: Collapse phase
scenes.cap: Collapse phaseWave 5 mined out. Shields dead, repair off, wrecks everywhere, two cripples circling. The rule that guarantees the match ends.

scenes.title: Match start
scenes.cap: Match startSpawn protection glowing, 3 ore in the bank, no defenses anywhere. The opening choice: turret, upgrade, or bank it?

scenes.title: Victory / defeat
scenes.cap: Victory / defeatSame screen either way, with REMATCH as the loud button. Eliminated players see this instantly — nobody watches bots finish.

uiPanels.head: Upgrade panel — the only place stats live
